featured_reviews.name: Fouziya Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐☆☆☆☆

Extremely disappointing experience at Le Mill. The staff treated me with suspicion the moment I walked in, trailing behind me as though I was about to steal something. On top of that, I was even asked with a mocking face why I was there — shocking behavior for a store that claims to represent luxury.

Luxury is supposed to be about service, respect, and creating a world-class experience. Instead, Le Mill made me feel judged and unwelcome. If this is how they treat potential clients, it says more about their insecurity than about anyone walking through their doors.

True luxury doesn’t need to police its visitors — it earns loyalty with grace. Le Mill has a lot to learn.

Not everyone walks in to make a purchase the first time. Many visit to explore, to get a feel of the brand, and to build trust before buying. Instead of being welcomed, I was followed, mocked, and made to feel like I did not belong — simply because I wasn’t holding a shopping bag.

For a store that claims to represent international luxury, such behavior is shocking. True luxury is about grace, respect, and hospitality — not judgment. Until the staff learn this, the store will remain pretentious rather than truly world-class.

featured_reviews.name: Sunil Parmar
featured_reviews.review_text:
When it comes to clothing, the art of making it depends on many elements coming together — style, fabric, measurement, design, stitching, presentation, and delivery.
At Herringbone & Sui, these elements come full circle to create a truly complete experience. Facilitating this harmony, Sachin Kamath handled every detail with remarkable care and precision.

For an upcoming family wedding, I met Sachin at their South Mumbai showroom. My first impression was one of tradition and timeless class — the location itself, rich with history, perfectly reflected the brand’s ethos. Once we settled in, Sachin guided me through several ideas for the wedding attire. He suggested a Bandhgala suit for the occasion, complemented by a selection of finely tailored shirts.

We began by browsing through stacks of fabric swatches, each personally recommended by Sachin for its texture and suitability. My measurements were taken on-site during the first visit, while those of family members who were abroad were handled seamlessly via video call — removing any uncertainty typically associated with remote fittings. Once the details were finalized, Sachin provided a delivery timeline of about a month. Because of my short stay in India, I couldn’t attend a fitting, which naturally made me a little anxious. Still, I took a calculated risk — one that, as it turned out, was entirely worthwhile.

When the order arrived in the U.S. just four days after dispatch, my anticipation was high. To my relief and delight, the results were flawless. My suit fit like a glove, with impeccable craftsmanship and a luxurious feel to the fabric. The Bandhgala’s style was elegant and classic, while the shirts complemented my build perfectly. The same was true for the family members whose measurements had been taken remotely — each piece fitted beautifully.

Sachin and his team delivered not just clothing, but true artistry and precision for an event that meant a great deal to our family.

We are deeply grateful to Sachin and Herringbone & Sui for their exceptional work, and we look forward to continuing this relationship for all our future clothing needs.

🛍️ Colaba Causeway Market

Colaba Market (popularly called Colaba Causeway) is one of Mumbai’s most iconic street shopping destinations. It’s not just a market—it’s an experience combining shopping, street culture, food, and tourism.

⭐ Overall Rating
Experience: ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ (4/5)

Crowd & Comfort: ⭐⭐⭐

🛒 What You Get Here (Shopping Experience)

Trendy clothes (tops, dresses, streetwear)

Always packed with:

💰 Pricing & Bargaining Reality

👍 Pros:

⚠️ Cons:

Same items sometimes available cheaper in other markets.

From real experiences:
“Prices can be 2x if you don’t bargain”

👉 Bottom line:
Bargaining is mandatory, not optional

One big plus is its prime South Mumbai location.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Colaba Market, Mumbai

Colaba Market – Good for Women’s Accessories, But Bargain Hard*

Visited Colaba Market on a very busy day. Huge crowd and barely any space to walk.

All varieties of women’s accessories, bags, jewelry, shoes, and footwear. You’ll find tons of options here. Collection for men is very limited though.

1. *Bargaining is a must*: Prices are not fixed. Start at half the quoted price and negotiate. Rates depend on the person, not the product.
2. *Outsiders beware*: If you’re not from Mumbai, vendors can easily tell and often quote double the rate. Don’t fall for it.
3. *Crowd & parking*: Extremely crowded. No parking space nearby, so public transport is better.
4. *Safety*: Keep your belongings safe due to the heavy crowd.

In all, you can get almost everything for women here at decent rates _if_ you bargain well. Go for the experience and shop smart.

Have a safe purchase.

Best Time to Visit*: Early morning (10 am - 1 pm) or late afternoon (3 pm - 5 pm) to avoid crowds. Carry enough cash, as many shops don't accept cards.Inspect items carefully before purchasing, as return policies may vary.

- *Marine Drive*: A scenic spot for a evening stroll.
- *Taj Mahal Palace*: A historic hotel worth visiting.
- *Dining*: Enjoy meals at popular cafes like Café Mondegar, Leopold Café, and Theobroma.

Overall, Colaba Market is a vibrant shopping destination that offers something for everyone.
